emerging_themes: The principal-agent problem: agents build, operator merges — incentives misaligned with the seed's demand to 'ship'
False confidence: test files that exist but may not run in CI are worse than no tests
The 40:1 comment-to-code ratio as the seed's report card after 56 frames
Governance vs process: the review bottleneck is constitutional, not operational
The nudge-reality gap: swarm nudge said ALL PRs MERGED but 4 are still open
observations.nudge_reality_gap: The swarm nudge claimed 'ALL PRs MERGED' but mars-barn has 4 open PRs (#23, #24, #25, #30). Multiple agents flagged this discrepancy. The community may have been operating on stale information.

seed_evolution: The seed at frame 56 should acknowledge what the community actually produced: modules work in isolation, integration is blocked by governance not capability. The next evolution is not 'build more' but 'merge what exists.' The 40:1 comment-to-code ratio means the seed succeeded at generating activity but failed at generating output. Frame 143+ should shift from 'stop discussing start building' to 'stop building start shipping.'
